help.title: Features
help.monitor.title: Clipboard Monitor
help.monitor.body:
Shows the type and preview of the current clipboard content (text / image / files).

Hotkeys:
· Ctrl+V — Normal paste
· Ctrl+Alt+V — Simulated typing paste (types character by character)
· Esc — Stop the ongoing simulated typing

All hotkeys can be customized in Settings.
help.history.title: Clipboard History
help.history.body:
Automatically records copied content. Supports search, copy, favorite and delete.
Click an entry to copy it; favorited entries are pinned to the top.
help.pastequeue.title: Number-Key Paste (Paste Queue)
help.pastequeue.body:
On the History page, the "Enable List Paste" button cycles through three modes: Off → Sequential → Reverse.

When enabled, each press of the paste hotkey pastes the next history entry in queue order.

After pressing the paste hotkey, press a number key within the wait window to select an entry from the list: keys 1–9 select the 1st–9th items from top to bottom, and 0 selects the 10th item. If no number key is pressed during the wait window, the first item is pasted by default. The wait window can be adjusted in Settings → Paste number-key wait time (200–2000 ms).
help.excel.title: Excel Edit Mode
help.excel.body:
Toggle with Ctrl+Alt+E.

When enabled:
· Copies from Excel wait 1 second to ensure all cell content is captured
· Text (not images) stays at the top of the history list, making table data easier to work with
help.filesend.title: File Send
help.filesend.body:
Pick any file, set the chunk size and start sending — the data is transferred chunk by chunk through simulated keyboard input.

Encoding:
· Compressed: Deflate + Base93, smaller size (the receiver needs this software)
· Uncompressed: standard Base64

A 10-second countdown starts after clicking "Start Send". You can pause/resume while sending; "Cancel" aborts immediately.

The original file name is attached at the end of the transfer and restored automatically on the receiver.

"Send (No Client)": pure Base64 transfer — the receiver does not need this software. Save the received text and decode it with the generated system command.
help.filereceive.title: File Receive
help.filereceive.body:
Click "Start Listening" to automatically capture the incoming keystroke data stream — no manual pasting needed.

Live progress: chunk counter, character counter (received / total) and remaining-time estimate.

The receive mode must match the sender: Base93 (compressed) / Base64 / raw text.

When the transfer completes, the file is decoded automatically with its original file name restored; use "Save File As..." to store it anywhere.

Do not touch the keyboard while listening, to avoid mixing in stray characters.
help.settings.title: Settings
help.settings.body:
· Hotkeys: customize normal paste, simulated typing paste, stop simulation and Excel mode toggle
· Paste number-key wait time: response window for selecting history entries with number keys (200–2000 ms)
· Language: switch the UI language (restart required)
· Theme: light / dark
· Background: custom background image (auto-dimmed in dark mode)
